messages:
amanda: Hey team — ready to ship the new ‘CLI-by-Example’ reference app today. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli-by-example :tada:

mike: Nice. Is there a short launch checklist? I can handle benchmark runs and ops notes.

amanda: Yes — checklist: blog post draft, benchmark narrative, demo video (2–3 mins), tweet thread, webinar signup page + UTMs, and inbound lead routing rules. Can you do benchmarks by EOD PT?

mike: On it. Will run small/medium/large sequence profiles across dedicated and hosted variants. Will post numbers in this thread. Any specific prompts to include?

olivia: Messaging note — keep lead copy focused on "fast local dev experience" and "predictable inference cost". Need 2 variants for A/B testing.

eli: I'll own the webinar page + GTM tracking. What UTMs do we want?

amanda: Use utm_source=dev-blog, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=cli_by_example_launch, + variant param. Example:```https://redwood.ai/cli-refapp?utm_source=dev-blog&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cli_by_example_launch&utm_content=variantA```

growth-bot: Ticket created: MARKETING-4213 "CLI-by-Example launch — leadflow + tracking" assigned to eli. ETA 2 days. :spiral_calendar:

mike: Quick benchmark sneak: hosted gpt-2 small (local sim) — cold start 180ms p50, 420ms p95; dedicated (c4) p50 120ms p50, p95 310ms. I’ll add full tables + token-cost calc.

olivia: For the blog, can we split the narrative into three sections: developer quickstart, performance story (benchmarks), and migration path to Dedicated/Private? That maps to funnel stages.

amanda: Yes. Devrel — can you make a 2-min demo showing "clone -> install -> run" + one benchmark call? We’ll embed in post and in webinar slide deck.

devrel: Yep. I can record a screen capture and cut to 2:30. Will add a short voiceover script. Want raw clips or finished edit?

amanda: Finished edit please. Publish source clips to the repo's /media folder. Add a short transcript for captions.

eli: For inbound routing: plan is to send signups with company size >50 to Sales SDR queue, smaller firms to self-serve nurture. Also tag by selected deployment (hosted/dedicated/private). I'll push rules to HubSpot and send mapping.

mike: I've uploaded the benchmark csv to the repo under /benchmarks/1765554321-results.csv and added a quick README with commands used.

amanda: Perfect. Olivia — can you draft the blog intro and two CTAs (enterprise / self-serve) by tomorrow AM?

olivia: On my list. Will ping for copy review when draft is up.

devrel: Demo video done — uploaded to GH release assets, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli-by-example/releases/tag/v1.0.0-demo. Also made short GIF for social.

amanda: Amazing. Final things: confirm canonical blog publish time (we want 10am PT Wed) and webinar date (live demo + Q&A) — Thu next week 11am PT. Any blockers?

eli: No blockers from tracking side. I'll share HubSpot flows + sample email copy in a separate thread.

mike: No blockers on bench. Will attach a short methods appendix for the post.

olivia: One small ask — can marketing craft two headline options? Long: "Ship locally, scale affordably: CLI-by-Example for predictable LLM inference" Short: "CLI-by-Example: fast local dev, predictable cost". Thoughts?

amanda: Both good. We'll A/B test in social. Put both in the CMS draft and I’ll pick before publish. :thumbsup:

growth-bot: Reminder scheduled: MARKETING-4213 follow-up in 24 hours.

amanda: Thanks team — extra kudos to Mike and DevRel for quick turnaround. I'll kick off PR and schedule internal review at 9am PT tomorrow.

mike: 👍

olivia: 👍

eli: 👍

devrel: 👌
